title: Analysis code for: Surveillance and selection of 5S ribosomal RNA genes in the human genome
description: Analysis code accompanying Sengl et al., "Surveillance and selection of 5S ribosomal RNA genes in the human genome." The repository is organised by manuscript figure and includes a panel-to-script manifest, captured software environments, database build and query scripts, public reference inputs, and reusable methods. Controlled-access human data are referenced by accession and are not included.
